import { Task, TaskStatus } from '../entities/Task';

export interface TaskRepository {
  findById(id: string): Task | null;
  findByProjectId(projectId: string): Task[];
  findByProjectIdAndStatus(projectId: string, status: TaskStatus): Task[];
  findByProjectIdAndAssignee(projectId: string, assigneeId: string): Task[];
  save(task: Task): void;
}
